says: fabsh saves ask as 'sent' after its one programs Cmd, and no step sets it back to 'due', so any life that loads the saved model never asks again. The runner's programs Cmd says 'a new build's table is the next answer' (runtime/Runner.ts listed), and docs/plan/tier-1.md:246 says a new program shows 'after the process starts again', which holds only for a life with no saved model.
proof: A scratch script ran the library's stepper on fabsh: a fresh init gives wake 0; after timer then programs_ok, init(saved model) gives wake null with cmds [] and programs ["fabrika/counter"], and a later timer asks nothing ([]).
cost: fabsh:1 boots on every build and keeps its saved model, so a program added in a later build stays 'not a built-in or a program' in that shell for good.
